cross_references.note: Rees-Levering primary home is CA_Consumer_Protection_Litigator per existing tether coordination. This standard is the vehicle-side reference copy. Pleadings drafted in Consumer_Protection; pattern-of-conduct analysis here.
§11713(k) (no-downpayment misrepresentation) and §11713(a) (untrue advertising) stack with Rees-Levering §2982 disclosure violations when the deceptive advertising induced the contract.
Rees-Levering (financing) and Song-Beverly (warranty) are parallel; both may apply to the same transaction. Pleads stack.
15 USC §1638 / Reg Z 12 CFR 1026 disclosure obligations run parallel to §2982. Federal remedies limited; state remedies (rescission + fees) stronger.
Spot-delivery dealers frequently combine yo-yo with repair-fraud. BPC §9884.9 missing estimates corroborate missing §2982 disclosures.
